violations.description: General employee practices. — --- Employee drinks and food found in new produce cooler mixed with the produce.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. - Wet cloth found not in saniti bucket in deli.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Wall/ceiling next to fryer in deli needs to be deep cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Floor in meat dept needs repair, Paint peeling.
